zh: 精简设置页与功能界面的冗余说明和内部术语，支持首页问候语随界面语言与品牌切换，修复消息回退弹窗在英文界面下的中文原因文本、单复数与零文件复选框问题。
en: Streamline redundant settings descriptions and internal jargon across the UI, localize home greetings by shell language and active brand, and fix Chinese-only rewind reasons, pluralization and empty-file checkboxes in the rewind confirmation modal.
